note: Twin of test_search_ranking.py::test_delivery_alias_identity_participates_in_relevance_order and test_search_scope.py::test_multi_token_query_requires_every_token. `unrelated` matches `exact` only through its delivery column `EXACT`; the two `Exact topic` variables match by name prefix.
